findings.label: Rotation order not guaranteed in RPC
findings.description: array_agg building v_to_requeue from unnest(p_requeued_ids) has no ORDER BY. On a retry where the de-dup guard fires for a subset of players, the remaining IDs are aggregated in an unspecified order, scrambling the doubles pairing rotation. Fix: array_agg(pid ORDER BY array_position(p_requeued_ids, pid)).

findings.label: Score stats double-counted on retry
findings.description: player_session_scores and pair_scores update loops run unconditionally even when alreadyRecorded is true. A retry after requeueAfterMatch throws will add scores a second time. Fix: move the score loops inside the if (!alreadyRecorded) block.

findings.label: security definer RPC bypasses RLS
findings.description: requeue_after_match runs with owner-level privileges, bypassing RLS on queue_entries and courts. Benign under current open policies, but a silent policy bypass if RLS is ever tightened. Document the intent or switch to security invoker.
